title: My AI content engine runs on one Claude plan
hook: Carousels, video editing, ideas, ideation, competitor analysis, scraping of data: all of this is part of a content engine I've built with Hermes and my Claude subscription.
summary: AI content engine: how I run carousels, video editing, ideas and competitor analysis from one Claude plan.
body: AI content engine: how I run carousels, video editing, ideas and competitor analysis from one Claude plan.

Here's what it does:
1. I message my Hermes bot on Telegram
2. Hermes uses my Claude Max plan to edit my videos and build my carousels
3. I send it a creator's Instagram video and it breaks down their style and what they're trying to say
4. It turns that into ideas for my next posts
5. Data scraping and competitor research all feed the same system
Comment CONTENT ENGINE and I'll send you everything I've built with AI to run it.
